event: Miami United FC defeated SCU Heat 1-1 (6-5 on penalties) in the UPSL South Region Final to advance to the National Semifinals.
SCU Heat eliminated from UPSL National Quarterfinals via penalty shootout loss to Miami United, ending a 14W-0L-3T regular season run with a +43 goal differential.
SCU Heat completed 2026 Spring season with a 14W-0L-3T record and +43 goal differential, establishing sustained on-field dominance in the Mid-Atlantic region.
Miami United FC (13W-1L-2T) advance to UPSL National Semifinals where they will face defending national champions New York Renegades FC.
West Texas Rush played UPSL National Quarterfinal vs. Central Kansas United in Abilene, TX; result unconfirmed.
Central Kansas United played UPSL National Quarterfinal vs. West Texas Rush in Abilene, TX; result unconfirmed.
NY Renegades FC (defending UPSL National Champions) confirmed as Miami United's semifinal opponent following South Region Final result.
Deportivo Rose City faced Next Level Soccer in UPSL West Region Final at Cardinale Stadium in Seaside, CA; result unconfirmed.
Detroit City FC II participated in UPSL National Quarterfinals; match result unconfirmed from public sources.
Fort Wayne FC hold a 7-game unbeaten run in USL League One, the longest active unbeaten streak in the league through the last confirmed standings update.
Corpus Christi FC have gone winless in all 10 league matches played through the last confirmed standings update, the longest active winless run in USL League One.
Pittsburgh Riverhounds SC midfielder/forward Trevor Amann earned USL Championship Player of the Week after a record-setting hat trick performance.
Spokane Velocity FC topped their group in the 2026 Prinx Tires USL Cup group stage, advancing to the knockout rounds as a Tier 3 club competing against Tier 2 opposition.
Brooklyn FC completed inaugural USL Championship debut season build-out, signing forward Shaan Hundal and other key pieces for their first professional men's campaign.
USL League Two 35-team single-elimination playoffs began July 13 with all 20 division winners receiving automatic berths; bracket continues through August 1.
Miami United FC advance to UPSL National Semifinals where both finalists will earn direct entry into the 2027 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup Tournament Proper.
